author: Chang Cheng
extra_representation_provenance: The four old n8000/seed43 CD/SPA absolute calibration-summary selections supplied these rank/threshold pairs; all four methods receive both pairs and the full ten-k grid for each attribute. No new validation outcome selects additions.
source_data_role: Existing official CelebA training subset and existing official development validation images; natural class proportions preserved; no test arrays.
boundary_policy: Retain every boundary flag and dimensional exclusion; no post-validation grid changes or substitutions.
validation_policy: Run only after all declared Fashion and matched CelebA CV jobs reach terminal status; serial profiles follow with no CV pool running.
earlier_results_role: Historical results preserved; this full common-grid matched 8-job block supplies the primary CelebA contribution for all four solvers.
anls_numerical_policy: Float64 NNDSVDa ANLS-BPP; at most 1000 outer NNLS sweeps; inner cap max(100,5*rank), relative KKT tolerance 1e-10 plus explicit roundoff allowance 256*float64_epsilon*max(NNLS design shape); outer relative initial projected-gradient tolerance 1e-4; no factor rescaling. Every inner/outer failure warns and invalidates. Iteration counts and tolerances are algorithm-specific and not equal optimization error. Ill-conditioned passive sets use the direct low-level LAPACK DGELSD wrapper, with explicit float64-epsilon rank cutoff and checked workspace/info; the high-level scipy.linalg.lstsq batched dispatcher is bypassed as a disclosed crash workaround.
supersedes: examples/celeba_four_solver_protocol.json; numerical repair before any new development-validation evaluation

numerical_repair.author: Chang Cheng
numerical_repair.reason: Repeated Windows native access violation in scipy.linalg.lstsq -> _batched_linalg._lstsq during ANLS-BPP original-design passive-set least squares.
numerical_repair.implementation_change: Call SciPy's low-level LAPACK DGELSD wrapper directly, preserving the original-design minimum-norm least-squares problem and float64-epsilon rank cutoff; validate workspaces and LAPACK status. Avoid the high-level batched lstsq dispatch.
numerical_repair.unchanged: Data, preprocessing, folds, predictive grids, NMF objective, NNDSVDa initialization, NNLS/KKT tolerances, iteration caps, factor geometry, metrics, and default-selection rule.
numerical_repair.receipt_policy: Copy only unchanged non-BPP calibration chunks and committed folds byte-for-byte after strict identity verification; retain source hashes and lineage. Rerun every ANLS-BPP chunk. Preserve all original results, including failures, as historical evidence.

anls_passive_lstsq_backend: scipy.linalg.lapack.dgelsd with explicit workspace query; original-design float64 minimum-norm solve
